severity_definitions.P0: False or contradictory document statement, or a completion-blocking mandatory derivation absent from the declared document scope.
severity_definitions.P1: A required definition, domain, cycle, typed inverse, or derivation is missing, while no displayed equality is directly disproved.
severity_definitions.P2: Nonblocking precision, locator, or presentation defect.

method.conditional_rule: A formula explicitly restricted to a residual complement, cycle, branch predicate, nonzero Berezinian domain, or proper isotopy is reviewed only in that declared domain.
method.external_blocker_rule: A nonzero obstruction inherited from a prior contract choice is not relabeled as a Step-3E document defect when Step 3E derives and records it exactly.

checks: Seven candidate families are listed.
Source conventions and coefficients are explicitly not imported.
Propagator signs, factors of i, determinant powers, projector coefficients, vertex coefficients, and D-transfer signs remain Project-derived.
Projection and Wick routes carry typed internal, external, density, projector, cycle, and eight-component NK data.
Projection routes require B_proj=1; intrinsic Euclidean equality requires the declared proper cycle isotopy; independent Euclidean ledgers are not forced equal.
Finite-cutoff BRST, CME, ST, density, and background defects are retained unless their separate hypotheses hold.
The standard determinant branches satisfy the factorized identity exactly.
The coupled branch uses the Hessian-support connected closure, a disjoint coupled/spectator partition, block nondegeneracy, and the explicit nonzero Berezinian domain.
The coupled determinant residual is retained and is not assigned zero without the supertrace, boundary-flux, and nonsingular-path conditions.
The sixteen unconstrained-vector slots and every four-slot chiral or antichiral block are explicitly ordered.
The flat standard gauge sector has 16+8+8+8=40 raw slots and a finite component emitter.
Vector-multiplier Schur and graded ghost inverses are multiplied on both sides.
FP color variance is lower AB for the kernel, upper AB for the inverse, and contracts to delta_A^C.
Direct EC cycles give the displayed scalar, vector, ghost, fermion, auxiliary, and multiplier signs.
The LC real cycle and positive damping yield the direct noncovariant temporal prescription; the unequal covariant candidate is recorded rather than identified with it.
The arbitrary-doublet rule remains a finite generator after branch data are fixed.
Classical, quantum-density, matter, gauge, potential, nonminimal, and admitted NK vertices are separated without double counting.
Every n-point momentum rule keeps incoming momentum conservation, leg-wise derivative position, spinor-derivative order, and color-word order.
Odd integrations by parts and forbidden chiral-measure transfers are explicit.
The nonsymmetric-Z chiral inverse has the correct transpose placement and all four products.
The transverse vector kernel, multiplier Schur block, reduced longitudinal block, and residual projectors are typed.
The flat FP supermatrix, inverse, four chiral/antichiral products, residual restrictions, and the LC/EC <c_R^{pair} c'_R> orientation and signs are explicit.
Arbitrary-background kernels do not reuse flat projectors.
Lorentz completion gives i*hbar*H_L^{-1}; Euclidean completion gives hbar*H_E^{-1}.
The direct EC scalar, vector, auxiliary, multiplier, odd, and nonminimal cycles and their orientation or positivity conditions are stated.
The ordered odd-pair Gaussian, graded determinant powers, and closed FP-loop sign are explicit.
The fully labeled graph sum retains vertex-copy and leg factorials and decomposes typed pairings into all group orbits.
Fourier phases, incoming momentum conservation, Wick momentum map, and Berezin deltas are fixed.
Lorentzian and Euclidean D algebra and all three projector numerators are exact.
The finite periodic momentum regulator satisfies the intertwiner gate; when it does not, the leakage defect is retained.
Box inverse and every analytic projector formula exclude kernel modes.
Flat and curved-background normal forms are separated and retain background curvature letters.
The unique dimension-minus-one multiplier normalization is outside the nonnegative interaction-word family.
FP isomorphism and full residual Hessian nondegeneracy are admission conditions.
Coupled, external, density, and BV-NK branches form a disjoint predicate partition with distinct carriers.
Untilded and independent tilded superpotentials and gauge kinetic tensors are both present with their invariance equations.
The direct L/E action uses the unique signature coefficient varkappa_R.
The gauge metric h_R is defined from kappa_R,AB and tilde-kappa_R,AB on its nondegenerate invariant color subspace.
Power counting, Kähler-exact exclusions, FI support, arbitrary vector valence, and curvature vertices are derived.
varkappa_L=+1 and varkappa_E=-1 are defined before use.
There is no unindexed kappa_L/E/R, rho_L/E/R, or omega_L/E/R collision.
The first varrho occurrence is its definition varrho_L=i, varrho_E=-1 at 3E.79a.
Internal and external fields have separate roles, domains, representations, parity, ghost number, dimensions, Lorentz data, Euclidean data, and Wick blocks.
LS, ES, LC, EC and all four NK branch labels are fixed.
